timeout.description: The default timeout for each chain of {@link LukeAsyncQueueNode}s

abortFlag.description: The flag to be switched on when the LukeCore instance should be aborted

abortReason.description: The reason why the abort flag is set

failureThreshold.description: Threshold for number of failed Jasmine blocks before test abort

failCount.description: Used to count number of failed Jasmine specs LukeCore instance has processed

currentJasmineBlock.description: Stores the type of jasmine block in current LukeCore lifecycle

planOnly.description: Indicates that only the Luke chain plan should be emitted when run() is called for a given Luke node

jasmineEnvSpec.description: The spec for the Jasmine environment

paused.description: Indicates if the LukeCore instance is paused

toResolve.description: The placeholder Promise used in a paused LukeCore instance

asyncQueue.description: Stores the async queue nodes to be run in the future

dynamicValues.description: A map storing values for {@link LukeDynamicValue}s

altSelectors.description: A map storing alternative selector info

skipQueueFlag.description: Whether to skip the remaining chains in the queue

title:
Luke is an all-purpose framework for UI integration and end-to-end tests. It drives
browsers and automates user interactions.

Luke can be implemented by various automation engines. LukeCore provides an abstract interface
for any concrete type backed by a specific engine. It also composes higher-order engine-agnostic
APIs.

Type parameters:
E is any type mixing {@link LukeWebElement}
C is {@link LukeCoreConfig} or any type mixing {@link LukeCoreConfig}
